detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 video

A browser will not let a page set the Referer header, so Portuguese broadcasters' playlists stay out of reach abroad. PT TV Tuner puts a small Node service in between: it asks for the playlist with the headers they expect and rewrites every child URI back through itself. 32 channels, MIT licensed.

https://github.com/ciberjohn/pt-tv-tuner
https://joaolealdasilva.medium.com/32-portuguese-channels-one-docker-stack-f917a9413c8a

#SelfHosted #Docker #Portugal
